playstyle: Four sturdy Bonesplitterz orruks, each with four wounds and a mix of melee and short-range ranged attacks. Their playstyle rewards gang tactics: whichever generic Destruction scroll is chosen, bonuses hinge on Flanking or Surrounding enemies, inspiring fighters who pile onto the same target or converting lucky dice into successes. Move 3 is unspectacular, but a free push toward the enemy leader each round keeps the mob aggressive. Victory comes from clustering tightly, isolating targets, and overwhelming them with combined attacks.
